title: バイオ・化学基礎実験・演習Ａ２（応用化学）
subtitle: Basic Experiments and Practice in Bioscience and Chemistry A2 (Applied Chemistry)
teachers:
TANAKA Koki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Learn the correct clothing and protective equipment suitable for experiments, use experimental tools correctly, and conduct experiments safely. Learn the specific information for the experiments and conduct experiments on your own. Prepare a report describing the experimental method and results and submit it by the deadline. Acquire the ability to conduct experiments by verifying and reporting on material learned in courses and through experiments.
advice:
Conduct experiments in analytical chemistry and organic chemistry. The objective of this experimental course is to acquire more knowledge than that learned in lectures and to gain skills in research, experimental methods, and reporting that are necessary to perform activities in Design Project III (4th year). If understanding experiments is difficult, you need to actively gain the understanding through reading, asking questions, and attending office hours, along with sufficient preparation and review of the experimental method and principles. Be sure to attend the guidance given for each experiment to learn about precautions, handling of experimental apparatus, safety training, and other important information.
Common to all experiments:
Experimental guidance, safety training, examination

Organic Chemistry experiments:
Fundamentals of distillation, nucleophilic substitution, esterification, and preparation of polymers
books:
Textbooks: Baio Kagaku Kiso Jikken/enshu AB (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing)
Reference books: Kenkyu no tameno Anzen Shishin (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing)
Reserved books: Jikken Deta wo Tadashiku Atsukau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Zoku Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Daremo oshietakurenai Jikken-note no kakikata (Kagaku Dojin Publishing)
requiredKnowledge: Bring an A4 size experimental notebook, scientific calculator, and ruler. Experiments should be conducted after reviewing the course material, understanding the experimental theory, and preparing the materials for the experiments. If the progress of the experiment is delayed, class time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the class on experiment days.

activityGoals.body: Wear appropriate clothing, understand the use of the equipment, handle reagents properly, and conduct safely.
Record experimental conditions and results accurately in the experimental notes.
Complete the experimental report using the prescribed format and explain it to others.
Describe observed phenomena and obtained data in experiments, based on principles of physics and chemistry.
Conduct the experiments on your own, according to the instructions.
Understand the fundamental principles of analytical chemistry, organic chemistry, and environmental chemistry.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. Use protective equipment and autonomously conduct experiments safely and competently.
2. Understand sufficiently the fundamental principles of volumetric analysis, organic synthesis, and chemical analysis, and conduct experimental operations accurately.
3. Understand sufficiently the fundamental principles and objectives of the experimental operation, summarize the experimental data obtained, and discuss the results.
4. Record experimental contents and results accurately.
5. Prepare a report using the prescribed format and explain it easily to others.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. Use protective equipment and conduct experiments safely.
2. Understand the fundamental principles of volumetric analysis, organic synthesis, and chemical analysis, and conduct experimental operations.
3. Understand the fundamental principles and objectives of the experimental operation, summarize the experimental data obtained, and utilize for discussion.
4. Record experimental contents and results.
5. Prepare a report using the prescribed format.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Conduct experiments in analytical chemistry and organic chemistry. The objective of this experimental course is to acquire more knowledge than that learned in lectures and to gain skills in research, experimental methods, and reporting that are necessary to perform activities in Design Project III (4th year). If understanding experiments is difficult, you need to actively gain the understanding through reading, asking questions, and attending office hours, along with sufficient preparation and review of the experimental method and principles. Be sure to attend the guidance given for each experiment to learn about precautions, handling of experimental apparatus, safety training, and other important information.
Common to all experiments:
Experimental guidance, safety training, examination

Organic Chemistry experiments:
Fundamentals of distillation, nucleophilic substitution, esterification, and preparation of polymers
